evidence.claim: Model knowledge: supported instrument/run metadata and notebook imports can reduce duplicate entry; local connector support and scientific completeness remain unverified.

assumptions: Actual instrument/run producer supplies sample ID, run ID, timestamp, settings, actual output reference and status. Geneticist verifies actual experiment and captures primary observations in s1; missing/ambiguous mappings remain manual in s3.
S2 transfers existing exact fields only. S3 reduces repeated identifiers/procedure references, not new method deviations or observed-result capture; complete final check stays in s4.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native supported imports/templates first; existing instrument/notebook integration earns zero saving. No planned procedure is treated as performed or predicted result as observed.
